description: This file defines the ModuleScreenHelper class which provides static methods to retrieve and reset the current module and screen information based on the HTTP request's URL path. It utilizes other framework components such as Request, RequestStack, and a service container.

classes.name: ModuleScreenHelper
classes.description: Provides static utility methods to retrieve and reset the current module and screen context based on the HTTP request.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current module and screen information based on the URL path, caching the result for subsequent calls.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Obtains the current HTTP request object from the service container's request stack.

methods.name: resetCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Resets the cached module and screen information to null.
